unlisted_practices: Explore the psychological and social impacts of thanatobots before any educational use.
Critically examine the ethical, cultural, and pedagogical challenges of thanatobot development before incorporating them into anatomy education.
Develop new consent frameworks for donors and their families, including for AI representations and broader uses of the thanatobot, before using thanatobots in education.
Establish legislation and legal and ethical boundaries protecting the dignity of the deceased and the welfare of students before educational use of thanatobots.
Treat digital remains of donors with dignity and do not use them for profit or as a means to an end.
Clarify whether a realistic avatar likeness of the donor helps or hinders learning outcomes and emotional responses before implementation.
Scrutinize AI products developed for anatomy education carefully, since developers may treat ethics and governance issues as future concerns.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/thought experiment discussing practical, ethical, and governance considerations of hypothetical AI 'thanatobots' in medical/anatomy education.
